verdict.rationale: The docs name x402 directly and back it with working pieces: dedicated x402 documentation for both paying for and charging for endpoints with the CDP SDK, Agentic Wallet CLI skills to pay for, search for and monetize x402 services, and MCP tools that check x402 payment requirements and pay x402-enabled APIs automatically. This is shipped tooling, not aspiration. Missing for 10: no documentation of ACP, MPP or AP2 support beyond x402, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the x402 flow.
